relatedPosts.title: Real-time YOLO Inference in the Browser
relatedPosts.description: Development of a web app for real-time YOLOv8 inference in the browser using WebAssembly (WASM). Explains how to run ONNX models with onnxruntime-web and why a web app was chosen for live performance.

relatedPosts.title: Sorting Algorithm Visualization & Sonification Plugin for Max for Live
relatedPosts.description: I built Soni.f(y, sorts) — a Max for Live device that sonifies sorting algorithm operations as a MIDI sequence.

relatedPosts.title: Building a Text Classifier with SVM using Doc2Vec and Optuna
relatedPosts.description: As a practice for using Optuna, I quickly wrote a text classifier using Doc2Vec. The output includes the model's accuracy, F1 score, and a Confusion Matrix using `pyplot`.
